name: example-brownfield
description: A hand-written dump of a database hejbro did not create (#714) -- CamelCase names beside snake_case siblings, Postgres-default foreign-key names, a shared check-constraint name, a leading-underscore column, a cross-schema enum reference against the grain of a foreign key, a three-schema "users" foreign-key chain, and the D106 corpus every add-catalog-inference round had to invent for itself -- with a standing, Docker-gated import -> baseline -> check witness.
